hook: Li built Baidu into China's dominant search engine over two decades, then pushed the company into generative AI, launching the Ernie chatbot in 2023 as one of the first large public chatbots released in China.
name: Robin Li

quote.text: Baidu envisions a future where we join forces with all to drive the evolution of AI, empowering every individual with access to state-of-the-art productivity tools and ensuring that the benefits of these advancements are shared by all.
quote.context: Robin Li, Baidu press release announcing Ernie Bot, March 16, 2023

moniker: Co-Founder, Chairman and CEO of Baidu

primary.name: Robin Li, Baidu Inc. investor relations management page
Baidu Unveils ERNIE Bot, Baidu press release via PR Newswire, March 16, 2023

timeline.event: Creates the RankDex search-ranking algorithm while at IDD Information Services
timeline.impact: Lays technical groundwork for the search engine he would found

timeline.event: Works as a staff engineer at Infoseek
timeline.impact: Gains search-industry experience in Silicon Valley
Launches what becomes China's dominant search engine
Consolidates leadership of the company as Chairman and CEO
Baidu becomes a publicly traded, US-listed company
Positions Baidu in China's generative AI and large language model market

quick_facts: Co-Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Baidu, a role he has held since founding the company in January 2000
Holds a bachelor's degree in information science from Peking University and a master's degree in computer science from the State University of New York at Buffalo
Created the RankDex search-ranking algorithm in 1996 while working at IDD Information Services, before founding Baidu
Led Baidu's launch of Ernie Bot on March 16, 2023, one of the first large public generative AI chatbots released in China
Serves on the board of New Oriental Education & Technology Group

achievements.title: Founding Baidu (2000)
achievements.impact: Co-founded Baidu, which grew into China's dominant search engine and listed on NASDAQ in August 2005.

achievements.title: RankDex search algorithm (1996)
achievements.impact: Developed a hyperlink-analysis search-ranking method before founding Baidu, later cited as foundational prior art in search-engine ranking.

achievements.title: Ernie Bot launch (March 2023)
achievements.impact: Directed Baidu's release of its Ernie large language model as a consumer chatbot, positioning the company in China's generative AI market.
